title: UAAP: Ateneo, National U still unbeaten in men's badminton
summary: National University and Ateneo de Manila University continue to lead the way after Day 2 of the UAAP Season 89 men's badminton team event on Sunday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
